### Step 1: Calculate Windmill Areas
Using the detected bounding boxes from the `baseball-diamond` category (assumed to represent windmills), we compute the area for each as:
$$
\text{Area (m²)} = \text{width (pixels)} \times \text{height (pixels)} \times (\text{GSD})^2
$$
